warnings: Preserve the existing concept warning: the collected guide says Visa Click to Pay (Secure Remote Commerce) would no longer be supported after January 20, 2026 while also calling SRC a current limited release.
Do not infer current support, merchant enablement or buyer eligibility from collection success, the stored snapshot, the country list or the page's current-tense wording.
Keep the iOS v4 and JavaScript v3 qualification attached to eligible merchants in the collected guide; do not generalize it to other SDK versions or integrations.
